title: The following are the Page Ones of two scripts of currently unmade films. Which first page do you like more and why?

commenti.body:
I’ve actually fully read Elephants, so maybe part of it is that there’s a whole mystery waiting behind door #2. That said, I much prefer the first page of Garden of Whispers. I feel like it sets up a character that I empathize with immediately and gives me an intriguing mystery to be solved, “what’s going on in this girls dreams?” 
Where as Elephants just gives me latte art (that we don’t connect to anything for the next 10-15 minutes, and when we do it doesn’t really matter much), and then a VERY unlikeable guy with his hair drops (that we honestly don’t like much by the end of the script either). I’m left slightly intrigued by why the coffee shop matters but outside of that I could stop reading and not be bothered.
The only thing I really didn’t like about the Whispers page is the first lines setting up the “surreal/not” framework, but it’s quick enough.
